title: Starter Deck 32: GREEN Roronoa Zoro
note: Copiado da optcgapi.com para os testes e para o primeiro início do servidor. A importação (npm run cards:import) tem prioridade sobre estes dados.

cards.name: Perona
cards.text: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If a Character is rested by your effect, set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text: [DON!! x3] [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If this Leader battles your opponent's Character during this turn, set this Leader as active. Then, this Leader cannot attack your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 7 or less during this turn.

cards.name: Kuina
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Character: Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 4 or less. Then, give up to 3 rested DON!! cards to your [Roronoa Zoro] Leader.

cards.name: Koushirou
cards.text: If your attribute Character with a cost of 5 or less other than this Character would be K.O.'d by your opponent's effect, you may rest this Character instead. [Blocker]

cards.name: Kouzuki Hiyori
cards.text: [Activate: Main] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards and this Character: If your Leader is [Roronoa Zoro], look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 attribute card or green Event and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
notes: Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Tashigi
cards.text: [On Play] Rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 6 or less. Then, give up to 3 rested DON!! cards to your [Roronoa Zoro] Leader.
notes: Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Luffy Is the Man Who Will Become the King of Pirates!!!
cards.text: [Main] Set your [Roronoa Zoro] Leader as active.
cards.trigger: Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +1000 power during this turn.
notes: Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.

cards.name: Ryuma
cards.text: [On Play]/[When Attacking] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's rested Characters with a cost of 4 or less.

cards.name: X.Drake
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Supernovas} type, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 5 or less. Then, set up to 1 of your DON!! cards as active at the end of this turn.

cards.name: Kin'emon
cards.text: [On Play] You may rest your attribute Leader or 1 of your DON!! cards: Draw 2 cards and trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Kouzuki Oden
cards.text: [On Play] Draw 1 card and up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base cost of 6 or less cannot be rested until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

cards.name: Dracule Mihawk
types: The Seven Warlords of the Sea
cards.text: [Your Turn] When this Character becomes rested, draw 1 card and trash 1 card from your hand.[On Play] If your Leader has the attribute, play up to 1 Character card with a cost of 5 or less that is either [Perona] or has the attribute from your hand.

cards.name: Silvers Rayleigh
cards.text: If your Leader has the attribute, this Character gains [Rush: Character].(This card can attack Characters on the turn in which it is played.)[On Play] Rest up to 2 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text: [Rush: Character] (This card can attack Characters on the turn in which it is played.)[On Play] If your Leader has the attribute, rest up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 2 or less.
